name: Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) Marksheet / Certificate
purpose: Proof of Date of Birth (DOB) and candidate's & parents' name spelling.
validity_cutoff: Must be issued by recognized board (CBSE/ICSE/State Board).
action_if_missing: If minor spelling variation exists with JEE rank card, submit an affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper at Exception Desk (L-103).

name: Class 12 (Qualifying Examination) Marksheet & Passing Certificate
purpose: Proof of fulfilling minimum 75% aggregate marks (or top 20 percentile) eligibility.
validity_cutoff: Passed in 2024, 2025, or 2026. DigiLocker copy accepted ONLY if digitally signed or stamped by School Principal.
action_if_missing: Unverified online printouts put on hold at Counter B until certified copy is arranged.

name: OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate
purpose: Reservation verification under Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer).
format_required: Original Central Government Format certificate + 2 photocopies
validity_cutoff: STRICT CUTOFF: Must be issued ON OR AFTER April 1, 2026. Community must be listed in the Central List of OBCs.
action_if_missing: State format or pre-April 2026 certificate is rejected at Counter B. Candidate must submit Undertaking (Annexure 7) at Exception Desk (L-103) promising submission within 7 days, else seat shifts to General in CSAB.

name: GEN-EWS (Economically Weaker Section) Certificate
purpose: Reservation verification under General Economically Weaker Section category.
validity_cutoff: STRICT CUTOFF: Must be valid for Financial Year 2025-2026, issued ON OR AFTER April 1, 2026 by Tehsildar or above.
action_if_missing: Requires Annexure 7 undertaking at Exception Desk if central copy is in transit.

name: SC / ST Caste Certificate
purpose: Reservation verification for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe candidates.
format_required: Original certificate in prescribed format + 2 photocopies
validity_cutoff: No annual expiry, but must be issued by authorized competent authority (DM / ADM / Tehsildar / SDM).
action_if_missing: Contact Exception Desk at L-103 if certificate lacks seal or officer designation.

name: Medical Fitness Certificate
purpose: Verification of medical soundness and fitness for academic and hostel residence.
format_required: Official JoSAA Annexure 8 format signed by registered Medical Practitioner (MBBS/MD) with Registration Number.
validity_cutoff: Issued within 30 days prior to physical reporting date.
action_if_missing: Visit Campus Primary Health Center (PHC, opposite Hall 3). Resident Medical Officer signs and certifies JoSAA medical forms after checkup between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM.

name: Anti-Ragging Undertakings (Student & Parent)
purpose: Statutory compliance with UGC Anti-Ragging Regulations.
format_required: Printed affidavits with online Reference Number from antiragging.in or amanmovement.org, signed by candidate and parent.
validity_cutoff: Generated for academic session 2026-2027 with Institute: IIITDM Jabalpur.
action_if_missing: Use Library 1st Floor Computer Terminals to submit online form and print at Central Xerox Center.

name: Gap Certificate / Year Gap Affidavit
purpose: Affidavit explaining academic hiatus for competitive exam preparation.
format_required: Original affidavit on Rs. 50 or Rs. 100 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, attested by a Notary Public.
validity_cutoff: Required for students who completed Class 12 in 2025 or earlier.
action_if_missing: Campus Notary Desk at Administrative Block Room 102 prepares on-spot stamp paper and notary attestation for Rs. 120.

name: JoSAA / CSAB Provisional Seat Allotment Letter & Rank Card
purpose: Identity and admission quota verification at campus entry and reporting desks.
format_required: Clean printed color/B&W copy of final round allotment letter + JEE Main 2026 Rank Card.
validity_cutoff: Final Round allotment letter with candidate photograph and QR code.
action_if_missing: Print out at Central Xerox Center (LHTC Ground Floor).

name: Fee Payment Receipts (SAF, PAF, and Balance Institute Fee)
purpose: Proof of Seat Acceptance Fee (SAF) and Partial Admission Fee (PAF) payment.
format_required: Transaction payment receipt printout showing JoSAA reference number.
validity_cutoff: Cleared before final token clearance at Counter L-104 (Accounts).
action_if_missing: Accounts counter staff at L-104 reconciles payments using candidate's JEE Application Number.
